## `app.adapters.nightshift` — [app/adapters/nightshift.py](../app/adapters/nightshift.py)
**Purpose:** Nightshift adapter: the only path from VEDA to a model (lanes `fast` / `deep`, retries, JSON mode, trace).  
**Called by:** —
- `class NightshiftError` — A model call failed after retries, or the adapter is misconfigured.
- `class LLMResult` — What one chat() call returns.
- `def lane_model(lane)` — Model name sent to Nightshift for a lane (from env). Refuses unknown lanes and anything `auto`.
- `def expected_model(lane)` — The model that must answer a lane (env METERLESS_EXPECT_<LANE>, else EXPECTED_MODEL).
- `def lane_app(lane)` — `meterless-app` header for a lane. Nightshift pins routing mode per app, so each lane has its own app.
- `def chat(lane, messages, agent, json_mode, thinking, tools, max_tokens, temperature, target_agent)` — Send one chat request through Nightshift on lane `fast` or `deep`. Returns LLMResult, raises NightshiftError.
- `def get_llm(lane, agent)` — Meterless engine-style injected generator for a lane: generator(prompt, ...) -> {"text": ...}.
- `def main(argv)` — CLI check: send a Coordinator-style planning prompt to the fast lane and print the plan.

## `app.adapters.pg` — [app/adapters/pg.py](../app/adapters/pg.py)
**Purpose:** Postgres write connection to veda-pg: used only by ingest jobs (never agents - they read via Zetaris).  
**Called by:** `app.ingest.jps`
- `class PgError` — veda-pg is not configured or not reachable.
- `def connect(autocommit)` — Open a write connection as the postgres superuser (VEDA_PG_PASSWORD). Raises PgError.

## `app.adapters.zetaris` — [app/adapters/zetaris.py](../app/adapters/zetaris.py)
**Purpose:** Zetaris adapter: run_sql() is the only way VEDA reads data (live, record, or SAMPLE_MODE replay).  
**Called by:** `scripts.setup_pg`
- `class ZetarisError` — A Zetaris call failed. `kind` tells the caller what to do:
- `class SqlResult` — What one run_sql() call returns.
- `def normalize_sql(sql)` — One statement, trailing ; removed, whitespace collapsed. Raises ZetarisError(not_allowed).
- `def query_hash(sql)` — Stable 16-char id for a normalised SQL string (fixture file name).
- `def coerce(value)` — Zetaris returns text: turn numbers into int/float, keep everything else (IDs, dates) as text.
- `def run_sql(sql, agent, purpose, limit)` — Run one read-only SQL statement through Zetaris (or replay it in SAMPLE_MODE). Returns SqlResult.
- `def run_ddl(sql, agent, purpose, setup)` — Run one allow-listed DDL statement (setup / self-healing). 'Already exists' counts as success.
- `def main(argv)` — CLI check: run one SELECT and print the rows.

## `app.ingest.jps` — [app/ingest/jps.py](../app/ingest/jps.py)
**Purpose:** JPS river-level collector: JPS Public Infobanjir (Kelantan) -> veda-pg `stations` + `river_levels`.  
**Called by:** —
- `class JpsParseError` — The JPS page no longer looks like we expect (layout change, empty table, duplicate ids).
- `class Reading` — One parsed JPS row: the station plus its latest level.
- `def normalize_name(name)` — Lower-case, drop '(F1)'-style tags and punctuation, collapse spaces.
- `def to_number(text)` — '[JPS reading]' -> [JPS reading]; '-', '', 'N/A', -9999-style sentinels -> None (never 0).
- `def to_utc(text)` — '22/10/2026 10:30' (MYT) -> aware UTC datetime; unparseable -> None.
- `def parse(html)` — Parse the JPS table into Readings. Raises JpsParseError if the page shape is wrong.
- `def newest_snapshot()` — Most recent cached snapshot path, or None.
- `def fetch()` — Return (html, source, path). Reuses a snapshot < 15 min old, else one live GET saved to the cache.
- `def store(readings, source)` — Upsert stations, insert new river_levels (duplicates ignored). Returns (stations, new_levels).
- `def ingest(from_file)` — One cycle: fetch (or read a file) -> parse -> store. Needs an active trace run. Returns a summary dict.
- `def main(argv)` — CLI: one cycle, a saved file, or a 15-minute loop.

## `app.trace` — [app/trace.py](../app/trace.py)
**Purpose:** Trace logger: one JSONL line per agent step / Zetaris call / Nightshift call in logs/trace-<run_id>.jsonl.  
**Called by:** `app.adapters.nightshift`, `app.adapters.zetaris`, `app.ingest.jps`, `scripts.setup_pg`
- `class Run` — One VEDA run: its id, trace file, step counter and write lock.
- `def redact(text)` — Mask secret-looking strings and any secret value present in the environment.
- `def summarize(value, limit)` — Redacted one-line summary, capped at `limit` characters.
- `def sentence(rec)` — One readable line for a trace record (used for stdout and the viewer).
- `def current_run()` — The active Run, or None.
- `def start_run(question, log_dir, quiet)` — Start a run: create logs/trace-<run_id>.jsonl, write a run_start line, make it the current run.
- `def step(agent, action, input_summary, output_summary, status, target_agent, confidence, retry_count, source, decision, duration_ms, details)` — Write one trace line for the current run and print it as a sentence. Returns the record.
- `def end_run(status, output_summary)` — Write the run_end line and clear the current run. Returns the trace file path.
- `def main(argv)` — CLI viewer: print a saved trace file as readable sentences.

## `scripts.codemap` — [scripts/codemap.py](../scripts/codemap.py)
**Purpose:** Generate docs/CODEMAP.md: every VEDA module -> purpose, public functions/classes, who imports it.  
**Called by:** —
- `def first_line(doc)` — First line of a docstring, or a placeholder.
- `def module_name(path)` — Dotted module name for a file path (package __init__ -> package).
- `def python_files()` — All .py files under the scanned roots.
- `def imported_modules(tree, this_module)` — Absolute names of modules this file imports (relative imports resolved).
- `def build()` — Parse every module and render the CODEMAP markdown text.
- `def main()` — Write docs/CODEMAP.md, or with --check fail if it is stale.

## `scripts.precommit` — [scripts/precommit.py](../scripts/precommit.py)

## `scripts.setup_pg` — [scripts/setup_pg.py](../scripts/setup_pg.py)
**Purpose:** Set up VEDA's Postgres store (veda-pg) and register it in Zetaris. Idempotent: safe to re-run.  
**Called by:** —
- `def docker()` — Run a docker command; returns CompletedProcess (never raises).
- `def ensure_container()` — Create veda-pg if missing, start it if stopped. Returns a short description of what happened.
- `def ensure_network()` — Join veda-pg to the Zetaris network so Zetaris reaches it at veda-pg:5432.
- `def connect(wait_s)` — Connect as the postgres superuser, waiting for the server to accept connections.
- `def schema_statements()` — Statements from db/schema.sql (comments removed, split on ';').
- `def apply_schema(conn)` — Read-only role with its own password, then the schema. Returns the tables now present.
- `def register_in_zetaris()` — CREATE DATASOURCE (once) + REGISTER DATASOURCE TABLES (every run, picks up new tables).
- `def smoke_check()` — COUNT(*) on every table through Zetaris. Returns {table: rows}.
- `def main()` — Run every setup step, tracing each one.
